title: Sum of Two Integers

content.problemStatement:
Sum of 2 numbers
Write a program to accept 2 numbers as input.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '10 20' produces expected output '' following problem rules.
Input '900 99' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Read two integer inputs and compute their sum.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Read two numbers A and B and output A + B.

hints: Read two integers from standard input.
Compute their sum using the '+' operator.
Use 64-bit integer types to prevent overflow.
learningObjectives: Master reading multiple inputs on a single line.
Choose data types with sufficient range.
